official_info_design_p: Yuyuko is a girl who is slightly taller than average, with pink hair that is sometimes short but on other occasions is longer. She is often surrounded by ghosts. She almost always wears a light blue kimono with designs that vary between flowers and ghost silhouettes; the kimono has dark blue decorations such as bows. She wears a blue hat/bonnet with a hitaikakushi on the front bearing a red ghost insignia, and she has a veil behind the hat. She wears black shoes.
official_info_abilities_p: She can manipulate the death of any living being, making someone's death a certainty. She can also manipulate spirits and ghosts; she possessed this latter ability even before she became a ghost.
official_info_personality_p: She has a friendly and kind personality with a carefree attitude. Because of some of the things she says, one might think she is somewhat foolish, but she has demonstrated her intelligence on multiple occasions. She has shown a great appetite through her dialogue in Touhou 8 and in several panels where she is seen eating.
official_info_lore_p: Yuyuko was a human approximately 1,000 years ago. Long ago, there was a cherry tree that came to be known as Saigyou Ayakashi. It was chosen as a place of death/burial by a well-known poet because of its beauty; afterward, the story became known and more people went to the tree to die. The tree became a youkai capable of tempting people to die beneath it. It was sealed by Yuyuko's corpse and some others. When her soul was judged by the Yama (Eiki Shiki), Eiki was impressed by her ability to control spirits, so Yuyuko was tasked with managing the souls of the dead. In return, she was allowed to reside in the Underworld.
official_info_games_th7_p: Final boss of the game and the cause of the incident involving the abnormally long winter and the theft of spring. Her motivation is to make the Saigyou Ayakashi bloom and steal its essence so that she can revive whatever is contained within it (without knowing that it was her own corpse).
official_info_games_th8_p: A playable character alongside Youmu Konpaku. They set out to investigate the unusual night but get sidetracked along the way because Yuyuko is thinking about food. In the end, they reach Eientei and deal with the incident. Together with Youmu, they form a team consisting of a fast character with focused shots (Youmu) and a slow character with spread shots (Yuyuko). Yuyuko's projectiles and spell cards are butterflies, dealing little damage but managing to attack almost every enemy on the screen.
official_info_games_th13_p: First boss of the game. Despite appearing early, after the fight it can be observed that her clothes are not damaged (as normally happens with Touhou bosses), suggesting that she was only testing the protagonist rather than fighting seriously. She gives clues about where the person responsible might be.
official_info_literature_ssib_p: Part of the plan to infiltrate the Moon while the main group (the Scarlet Devil Mansion's ship group) distracts attention. Yuyuko steals an alcoholic drink and drinks it with Yukari, Ran, and Youmu at the end of the manga.
official_info_literature_fds_p: She is involved in some of the early incidents, even becoming a victim, but later awakens and takes part in helping with the investigation, though only during the first volume of the manga.
official_info_literature_sbnd_p: She only appears as a cameo character in some chapters.
official_info_literature_osp_p: She appears as a supporting character in the 'test of courage' organized by the Hakurei Shrine and the Three Fairies of Light, where she sends Youmu to participate.
official_info_literature_vfs_p: She appears as a tertiary character in one chapter to observe the cherry blossoms with Youmu at the Hakurei Shrine. The Three Fairies of Light, together with Clownpiece, play a prank on Youmu with the Torch of Insanity. She also appears as a background character in other chapters.
official_info_youmu_p: Yuyuko's personal gardener and subordinate, often appearing together with her, while at other times she is sent to carry out certain tasks outside the Underworld.
official_info_yukari_p: A close friend of Yuyuko even before her death. Yukari allows her to know about and even take part in her plans, which she is normally very secretive about.
official_info_eiki_p: The role of Administrator of the souls of the dead was granted to her by the Yama (Eiki), so she is known to Yuyuko, who respects Eiki.
